question: What fields does the OrderLine table have, and what is its primary index?

must_mention.note: unique primary index on OrderNum + LineNum

notes: 8 fields; the four probed are the discriminative ones (index pair, price, status, item).

question: Where is a customer's credit limit stored?

must_mention.note: the CreditLimit field (exact name, no space)

notes: Customer.CreditLimit. 'creditlimit' (one word) cannot be satisfied by echoing the question's 'credit limit'.

question: Which table records posted invoices, and which procedure creates records in it?
notes: CREATE ArHist happens only in ar-invoice.p main.

question: How are new order numbers generated?

must_mention.note: generated from the sequence next-ord-num (via NEXT-VALUE)

notes: ASSIGN s-ordnum = NEXT-VALUE(next-ord-num) in oe-entry.p#create-order-header.

question: What are the possible order status values?

must_mention.note: defined as preprocessor constants in include/ordstat.i

notes: Four ORD-* values in ordstat.i.

question: Which procedure calls allocate-item?

must_mention.note: via the persistent handle gh-alloc (RUN ... IN)

notes: RUN allocate-item IN gh-alloc inside add-order-line.

question: Which other programs does order entry run?
notes: Outbound RUN edges of oe-entry.p.

question: Which procedures start the inventory allocation manager as a persistent procedure?
notes: Both contain RUN inv/inv-alloc.p PERSISTENT SET gh-alloc.

question: What calls ar-invoice.p?

must_mention.note: inside the per-order posting flow (retry block / batch context)

notes: Single caller, inside oe-post.p's retry block.

question: Which OrderService methods delegate to legacy .p procedures, and which procedures do they run?
notes: GetOrderTotal reads OrderLine directly - it does NOT delegate (distractor).

question: What happens when an order is posted?

must_mention.note: an invoice is created via ar-invoice.p
the order status flips to Posted
Customer.Balance goes up by the invoice amount

notes: Per-order transaction in oe-post.p: skip-check, invoice via ar-invoice.p (retry loop), status flip; ar-invoice.p writes ArHist and rolls the amount into Customer.Balance.

question: Walk through order creation, from entry to inventory allocation.

must_mention.note: credit check runs (before lines are added)
allocation goes through the persistent allocation manager
a short allocation backorders the line instead of failing the order

notes: oe-entry.p main flow; allocation via RUN allocate-item IN gh-alloc.

question: When does a customer's balance get updated?

must_mention.note: the invoice amount is added (balance only goes up here)

notes: Customer.Balance = Balance + ArHist.Amount, only in ar-invoice.p main; cash receipts live outside the corpus.

question: What happens when an order is cancelled?

must_mention.note: allocation is released via deallocate-item for Ordered lines
line and header statuses are set to Cancelled
only orders still in Ordered status can be cancelled (shipped/posted go to RMA)

notes: oe-cancel.p: status guard, deallocate-item IN gh-alloc per Ordered line, lines + header to Cancelled. Backordered lines were never allocated.

question: Where are the shared order-entry variables and the shared customer buffer defined?
notes: DEFINE {1} SHARED in oeshared.i; oe-entry.p includes it with NEW.

question: Which procedures rely on the shared customer buffer sb-cust?
notes: Defined in oeshared.i; positioned by entry, read by credit + pricing.

question: If a customer orders 60 units of something, do they get a better price?

must_mention.note: an extra 5 percentage points of discount

notes: apply-discount: >=50 adds 5, >=100 adds 10, cap 25. 60 gets the 50-break only.

question: Which report lists backordered order lines?

must_mention.note: selects lines by backordered line status ({&LIN-BACKORD})

notes: for each OrderLine where OrderLineStatus = {&LIN-BACKORD}.

question: Which procedures update the Item table?
notes: TRAP: oe-post.p's Item update is commented out (pre-2007). Citing oe-post.p is not gold/acceptable, so the trap shows up as lost citation precision.

question: Which procedures create or change Order header records?
notes: Four writers; OrderService only delegates.
